semantics.input: train owner/id, carriages/spacings, serialized entity/passenger seat payloads, dimensions and graph/station links
semantics.output: fresh train constructed with stored owner and physical carriages; station reservation rebound after load; serialized entity copied

Live passenger saveAsPassenger results stored per seat; retained serialized passengers merged; missing graph represented null. This substantive owned vehicle reconstruction counts1, carriage helpers0. ScheduleRuntime separately owns instruction completion and is not included in this credit.
semantics.application_limit: Malformed passenger Seat key substring/Integer.valueOf unguarded; reserved/occupied UUID getters unguarded. Carriage storage underlying implementation and native entity re-add transaction not fully traced: no claim all cargo/seat respawns lossless. Multiple dimensional reads share storage owner; boundaries retained.

semantics.trigger: ToolStack verifyTag/ensureHasData/rebuildStats/getPersistentData with MaterialIdNBT, MaterialNBT, StatsNBT, MultiplierNBT
semantics.input: saved physical tool materials/paid upgrades/persistent modifier data; derived stats/multipliers/volatile data; registry readiness
semantics.output: resolve material redirects preserving variant then rebuild derived data only after definition/material/modifier/tags readiness; retain persistent data in rebuild context
semantics.preservation: Read complete verifyTag/rebuildStats/ensureHasData plus getters/setters, full material parsers/serialization and stats/multiplier pair. This is one gameplay tool restoration owner, not extra counts for helper fields. MaterialIdNBT is described as display-oriented but verifyTag really uses it before actual MaterialNBT gameplay decode. Missing/wrong material list returns EMPTY; invalid entries become UNKNOWN preserving list positions. Multiplier loader accepts registered numeric stats, clamps below0 and omits identity1; stats unknown keys ignored.
semantics.application_limit: Persistent/volatile distinction is useful for root Clone whitelist; do not transplant all tool NBT or claim redirect is item remap. Rebuild may alter damage/broken state when durability changes. Stats decoder does not use builder clamp; material fillers randomize only missing initialization after data readiness. Unknown stat entries are dropped on serialization, not opaque preserved. No native runtime execution.

semantics.application_limit: Missing timestamp0 allows exchange after world age interval; no dimension clock conversion. Devil payment method no explicit server guard visible. Item delivery transaction not atomic. Cthulhu comparator case reads/writes light positions but omits lastPrismarineTime, allowing reset across load; included as negative support0, no additional near-clone credit.

semantics.output: persisted paid duration/multiplier continues decrement without consuming replacement fuel until duration0; reactor computes energy production from live restored multipliers
semantics.preservation: Read both implementations and actual reactor coefficient consumer. Combustor identical control shape/API role clone grouped1, not two cases; distinct fuel-paid effect duration from activator unconsumed source work. Timer is paid entitlement, not blanket temporary-state discard.
semantics.application_limit: Missing multiplier resets0 even if saved positive progress; negative progress never decreases to0/newfuel, raw nonfinite multiplier accepted. Duration endpoint expiry clears effect before optional replacement fuel same tick; no absolute deadline/offline decay. No coefficient provider implementations or runtime tested.

reviews.reason: 不是把 Train.read 的 MigratingPoints 字段再计一次。独立增量是轨道拓扑改变时，把所有轮位的旧有向边/沿边距离与空间采样点转换为新图中的一致轮位集合；失败保留检查点以便后续重试。原有车辆 owner/乘客重建账目只覆盖实体身份、乘客座位和维度恢复，未覆盖这种先完整匹配再提交的拓扑约束。完整检查点产生、持久化、恢复、实际轮位消费者合为1，TrainMigration reader/几何 helper/每轮各0。
owner_consumer_chain: TrackGraph.removeNode 165-176: 移除正在使用的节点触发同图车辆 detach。
Train.detachFromTracks 835-840: 遍历实际 bogey travelling points 生成检查点，再将 graph=null。
Train.write/read 1199,1242-1243: 检查点通过实际车辆持久字段恢复；earlyTick 193-200 启动重新挂接。
TrainMigration.tryMigratingTo 36-100: 优先原有向边，否则仅非曲线候选进行同方向近距离几何探测。
Train.reattachToTracks 883-928: 每点消除不匹配图，仅全点成功的图才给实际轮位迁移；失败 cooldown40、derailed=true，保留检查点。
TravellingPoint.migrateTo 407-415: 从映射列表移除首项并设置真实节点、沿边距离和边引用。
limits: 原边仍存在时直接使用旧距离，未与新边长核对。
空间 fallback 不处理曲线；搜索限于距采样点32格的节点起点，以同向和1/64半径相交判定；未审核依赖维度/向量辅助类的完整语义。
HashSet 的首个全匹配图不保证确定顺序；设置 graph 后逐点 mutate，无 rollback 或跨保存事务。
未校验任意坏 NBT、点数变化、空边；静态条件下的全点预匹配不等于无损或 crash-atomic。
这是拓扑重绑定检查点研究，不是已证明历史格式版本升级或 Dynasty 原生验收。

reviews.reason: 不是因 fluid/overslime 换名计数。工具自持有的已付款 deadline+rate，与实际流体库存扣除、持有者世界时、级别决定的补给周期和可消耗护盾容量耦合；存档恢复的是未来补给资格而非只剩一份流体或重启满时长。现有 FuelModule 是机器剩余计数加温度的熔炼消费者；Embers 是在线递减的系数持续期；Occultism 交换在付款当下给物品后限制下次购买；ToolStack 账目是材料重定向和派生统计重建。这些没有覆盖可移动工具以绝对到期时间消费已付补充资格的生命周期，因此本条完整付费/恢复/消费链建议最多1。所有 NBT/tank/capacity/hooks/盾伤害 helper 均只支持0。
owner_consumer_chain: ModifierProvider 1507 注册 overburn 模块、1000mB容量和 tank handler。ModifiableItem.inventoryTick 319-322 委派 heldInventoryTick，后者 ToolStack.from(stack) 并调每 modifier INVENTORY_TICK。
ToolStack.from 147-183 对正常已有 tag 工具不复制 NBT；构造保存同一 tag 引用。getPersistentData 617-628 对实际 persistent compound 包装，新建时写回该工具 NBT。
FuelInfo.read/write 65-80 用 modifier id compound 存 expiration/rate；onRemoved 50-51 删除该资格。
Overburn 94-127 仅服务端到周期、非正在使用、盾未满时，过期才查匹配 fuel；真实扣工具流体，部分量按比例缩短时长。
Overburn 132-147 仅跨度足够下一周期才持久化新资格，但本次非空短资格仍可补一次；未过期复用已付 rate，无再次流体扣除。
OverslimeModule/CapacityBarHook 读取/写入工具持久 overslime，补给受当前容量和 overworked 限制；DurabilityShieldModule 64-98 实际减少 shield 并减免工具耐久伤害，helper 不是第二条 credit。
limits: expiration < time 才续费，恰好到期仍有效；time+duration 与 duration*interval 有溢出/截断边界，level 仅限上界6。
盾已满或正在用物品时跳过补给，世界时间仍走；没有离线补发，不把它当永久护盾或全额保证。跨维度时钟一致性未验证。
outer compound 有类型检查，inner expiration/rate 无显式类型/范围校验；原生默认行为没有本轮外部源码验证。
ToolStack 正常引用接线已补读，仍未原生读盘/写盘测试；材料JSON生成加载、完整 modifier registry dispatch、配方 lookup 以及全部伤害入口没有展开。
付费与持久资格写入没有磁盘事务；不保证进程中断不丢不重，也不赋予玩家死亡Clone保留权。
